config.conanProfiles: Extra Conan -pr profile files appended to every build (maintainer/dev-machine adaptations; not shipped defaults).
config.copilotRenameSession: Set the Copilot chat session title to "HeT DevTools Agent" the first time a HeT entry opens it (tries the rename commands only once per session). Keep this on unless renaming annoys you.
config.envConanRemote: Mirror of ConanCenter used INSIDE the managed lane (updates the lane's private CONAN_HOME remote; never your ~/.conan2). Empty = conancenter.
config.envHttpProxy: HTTP(S) proxy for the managed lanes (pip/conan/apt): http://proxy.corp:8080. Also honoured by apt inside the WSL/Linux lanes.
config.envKeepRootfsCache: Keep the downloaded rootfs cache when removing the managed environment (faster re-creation).
config.envMode: Which environment lane to use. `auto` (default) prefers the isolated managed lane when the host can build one (Linux: apt + `python3`), falling back to the native toolchain; `managed` always asks for the isolated lane; `native` uses the tools on your PATH. A project's `metadata.json` → `toolchain` outranks this setting.
config.envMode.auto: auto — prefer the isolated managed lane, otherwise native
config.envMode.managed: managed — always use the isolated lane
config.envMode.native: native — always use the tools on my PATH
config.envPipIndexUrl: Corporate mirror for the managed lanes: exported as PIP_INDEX_URL (pip: conan/cmake/ninja and the docs stack). Empty = default PyPI.
config.envWslRootfsSha256: Expected sha256 of the rootfs above. Required whenever wslRootfsUrl is set (a mirror may differ from the official image).
config.envWslRootfsUrl: Override the Ubuntu 24.04 WSL rootfs source for the self-provisioned distro (http(s) / file:// / absolute path / UNC share). Intranet mirrors MUST also set wslRootfsSha256 — there is no "skip verification" switch.
config.hudDisableHud: Disable the hover HUD and use the quick list instead (the chip Snooze/HUD toggle writes this).
config.hudFontSize: Hover HUD font size in px (10–20; default 13.5).
config.netDockerMirror: Docker registry mirror for MegaLinter. Empty (default) = disabled, because the public China mirrors are mostly dead; point this at your intranet registry instead.
config.netMirrors: Only used when `het.net.profile` is `custom`. Per kind: pip / apt / rootfs / ghAccel — each a string or an array (array = fallback order).
config.netProfile: Which mirrors to use. `auto` follows the VS Code display language (zh* → China mirrors). The extension never shows a dialog for this — it logs one decision line to the output panel.
config.netProfile.auto: auto — China mirrors when the display language is Chinese, official sources otherwise
config.netProfile.cn: cn — always use China mirrors (NJU first; TUNA / Aliyun as fallback)
config.netProfile.global: global — official sources only (same as an unconfigured install)
config.telemetryEnabled: Opt-in anonymous telemetry (default OFF): counts activations and feature usage locally. No code, no personal data, nothing leaves your machine in this version.
description: A plain-language engineering cockpit for fcpp-based C/C++ libraries: build, test, dependencies, docs, quality gates, release and board benchmarks — all one click.
